content.Indication: Progressive or persistent severe cardiac dysfunction and/or life‑threatening ventricular arrhythmias and/or Mobitz type 2 second‑degree or higher AV block with lack of short‑term (<1‑2 weeks) expected response to usual medical treatment. Aim is to identify aetiology and indicate specific treatment (e.g. giant cell myocarditis, eosinophilic myocarditis, cardiac sarcoidosis, systemic inflammatory disorders).
content.Number_and_sites_of_the_samples: Minimum of 5 but preferably at least 7 samples: 3 for pathology, 2 for infections (DNA, PCR) and 2 for RNA viruses/viral replication. Left and/or right ventricle. CMR or PET guided sampling may be considered.
content.Aetiology: Quantitative PCR viral genome analysis for common cardiotropic viruses (parvovirus B19, HHV4, HHV6, enteroviruses, adenovirus and coxsackievirus) by rtPCR. Viral mRNA for active viral replication may be assessed (low sensitivity). On indication, search for CMV, HIV, Borrelia, Coxiella burnetii and SARS‑CoV‑2.
content.Diagnosis_of_inflammation: Immunohistochemistry with staining for anti‑CD3, CD4, CD8 or CD45 antibodies for lymphocytes; anti‑CD68 antibodies for macrophages; and anti‑HLA‑DR antibodies.
content.Therapeutic_implications: Immunosuppressive therapy may be indicated based on EMB results as in giant cell myocarditis or eosinophilic myocarditis and possibly in sarcoidosis, vasculitis or selected patients with increased cardiac inflammation of unknown origin after multidisciplinary counselling.
content.Antibiotics: Antibiotics for Borrelia (Lyme disease) where indicated.
content.Antiviral_therapy: Consider antiviral therapy for HIV, CMV, HHV6 pending on viral load and evidence of viral replication (mRNA).
content.Abbreviations_note: CMR = cardiac magnetic resonance; CMV = cytomegalovirus; DNA = deoxyribonucleic acid; EMB = endomyocardial biopsy; HHV = human herpes virus; HIV = human immunodeficiency virus; HLA‑DR = human leucocyte antigen‑DR isotype; mRNA = messenger ribonucleic acid; PCR = polymerase chain reaction.
